Holding is a theorem; entry only with reading-from-the-share fixed as a property of the law (that a rule comes to be so set is only said); using up only on a needed stock, the tie from share to draw given. Exits: sufficient conditions, some exact, none shown complete. Locked and overdrawing are independent: one built course returns to the lock and never ends.
